education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering

projects.name: Job Board API
projects.description: Built a dual-role job platform backend supporting Employer and Candidate accounts with JWT authentication and ownership-based access control. Implemented job posting CRUD, search/filter/pagination, and an application workflow with status tracking (applied, reviewed, accepted, rejected). Integrated Cloudinary for resume uploads and wrote a Pytest suite covering 20 passing tests across auth, job, and application flows. Containerized the application with Docker, resolving WSL2/virtualization and dependency issues for a reproducible local environment. Resolved Python 3.14 compatibility issues with psycopg2, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic and bcrypt by pinning versions. Fixed a bcrypt and passlib version conflict while setting up Docker on Windows with WSL2.

projects.name: TenantCore
projects.description: Designed a multi-tenant SaaS backend with Admin and Member roles, enforcing tenant-scoped data isolation and role-based access control. Implemented secure authentication using bcrypt password hashing and JWT-based session management. Built RESTful APIs with SQLAlchemy ORM over PostgreSQL, validated with Pydantic schemas. Wrote a Pytest test suite and containerized the service with Docker; published to GitHub with full setup documentation.

experience_summary: Aspiring Backend Developer and fresh graduate with hands-on experience building production-style backend systems through self-directed, curriculum-based projects. Skilled in Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL, with a strong grasp of authentication, role-based access control, and RESTful API design. Comfortable working across the full backend lifecycle: schema design, testing, containerization, and deployment.
